'''Una Gitori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] criminal who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was a member of the [[Valarian Syndicate]], a criminal organization led by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /> However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Gitori betrayed Lady Valarian by selling information to her rival, the infamous [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] known as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. As a result of betraying Valarian's trust, and jeopardizing her many business deals, Valarian requested that a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] him on her behest. The spacer therefore found Una Gitori near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and killed him during a brief firefight.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Una Gitori was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Una Gitori was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

Because Una Gitori spawned under the generic "lost_aqualish_marksman" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He could either appear as a female Ualaq Aqualish, or as a male Ualaq Aqualish. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Gitori as male, this article assumes that the male Ualaq Aqualish depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

[[File:UnaGitori.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Cut depiction of a Human female Una Gitori.]]
With "[[W:c:swg:Publish 20 Notes for 19 July 2005|Publish 20]]" released on [[July 19]], [[2005]], it was announced that the "Valarian Quest Series" of which Gitori was a part would be phased out during "[[W:c:swg:Publish 22 Notes for 16 August 2005|Publish 22]]" to make way for a revamped questline during "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]."<ref name="SonyCite-Valarian Quest Update">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Current%20Publish|text=Valarian Quest Update}}</ref> While the Valarian Quest Series was fully deactivated by Publish 23 on [[August 31]], [[2005]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref> the newly proposed [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark] was never fully implemented to replace it.<ref name="SonyCite-In Development">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> Nevertheless, files pertaining to this updated questline could be found in the game's directory tree files. They indicated that Una was intended to be part of the a new quest named "Fencing." Among these files is an updated version of Gitori, simply designated as "tatooine_una." An emulated depiction pulled from this character's Interchange File Format reveals that the updated character would have been a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] female, instead of an Aqualish as in the original Valarian Quest Series.<ref>{{GalaxiesAED}} &mdash; tatooine_knives_fencing.stf, shared_dressed_tatooine_una.iff</ref>
